text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In early April, Curren Bouquetd'or had a 
proposition for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Both the Oka Sho and the Wasurenagusa Sho 
are held at Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Could you take that day off, and go cheer 
together with me—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You was scheduled to run in the 
'Wasurenagusa Sho', while Gran Alegria and 
Chrono Genesis were set to compete in the 
'Oka Sho'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason Loves Only You won't be running 
in the Oka Sho is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It was because swelling was discovered in 
her legs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Due to this, she was unable to run in 
the race scheduled before the Oka Sho, 
leaving her unprepared to enter the Oka 
Sho itself, forcing her to withdraw.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Setting her sights on the Oaks, she 
decided to proceed to its trial race, the 
Wasurenagusa Sho."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—What happened at the Oka Sho is truly 
regrettable. Even so, I intend to pour 
everything into preparing for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
âLoves-san must be carrying so many 
feelings entering this race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is a grand stage for Gran-san 
and Chrono-san, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to cheer with all my might from up 
close for everyone's gallant figures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the race, we held off on 
training and running, and decided to head 
to Hanshin together.
